yowthe: When that it remembreth me Up-on my yowthe, and on my Iolitee, It tikleth me aboute myn herte rote.
yow: My lord, ye woot that in my fadres place, Ye dede me strepe out of my povre wede, And richely me cladden, o your grace To yow broghte I noght elles, out of drede, But feyth and nakedness and maydenhede.

An' jes' how to ketch ol' Bah.
But I tell yow now you mus'
Gin me one fat chicken fus'."

O cruel goddes, that governe This world with binding of your worde eterne, And wryten in the table of athamaunt Your parlement, and your eterne graunt, What is mankinde more un-to yow holde Than is the sheepe, that rouketh in the folde?
yowl:
Cats is funny creatures an' I like to make 'em yowl,
Gramma alwus looks at me with a awful scowl
